dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: How's your complaint email going, Nam?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊz jʊr kəmˈpleɪnt ˈiːmeɪl ˈɡoʊɪŋ, ˈnɑːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Slowly. Listen: "The room did not have a sea view. The pool was closed." It sounds like a list.
dialogue.reading: ˈsloʊli. ˈlɪsən: ðə ˈruːm dɪd ˈnɑːt ˈhæv ə ˈsiː ˈvjuː. ðə ˈpuːl wʌz ˈkloʊzd. ɪt ˈsaʊndz ˈlaɪk ə ˈlɪst.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Connect your ideas. Try, "Furthermore, the swimming pool was closed."
dialogue.reading: kəˈnɛkt jʊr aɪˈdiːəz. ˈtraɪ, ˈfɜːrðərmɔːr, ðə ˈswɪmɪŋ ˌpuːl wʌz ˈkloʊzd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: "Furthermore…" OK. And then, "In addition, the staff were rude when I complained."
dialogue.reading: ˈfɜːrðərmɔːr… oʊˈkeɪ. ənd ˈðɛn, ɪn əˈdɪʃən, ðə ˈstæf wɜːr ˈruːd wɛn aɪ kəmˈpleɪnd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! The receptionist said it wasn't her problem and walked away.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ðə rɪˈsɛpʃənɪst ˈsɛd ɪt ˈwʌzənt hɜːr ˈprɑːbləm ənd ˈwɔːkt əˈweɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's unacceptable. You should write that.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˌʌnəkˈsɛptəbəl. juː ʃʊd ˈraɪt ˈðæt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: "Moreover, the receptionist's behavior was unacceptable." Is that too strong?
dialogue.reading: mɔːrˈoʊvər, ðə rɪˈsɛpʃənɪsts bɪˈheɪvjər wʌz ˌʌnəkˈsɛptəbəl. ɪz ðæt ˈtuː ˈstrɔːŋ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, it's fine. It's formal, but it isn't rude.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪts ˈfaɪn. ɪts ˈfɔːrməl, bʌt ɪt ˈɪzənt ˈruːd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And at the end, "I am very dissatisfied with my stay."
dialogue.reading: ənd ət ði ˈɛnd, aɪ æm ˈvɛri dɪsˈsætɪsfaɪd wɪð maɪ ˈsteɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Perfect. They'll have to answer that!
dialogue.reading: ˈpɜːrfɪkt. ðeɪl ˈhæf tu ˈænsər ˈðæt!
